name: Clear Ledger
eyebrow: A clearer view of the business you’re building
headline:
Keep the books.
Find your focus.
intro: Monthly bookkeeping, catch-up support and useful reporting for owner-led businesses. Start with your workflow and build a more consistent month-end routine.
about_title: Good records. A more useful conversation.
about_body: Clear Ledger is a fictional bookkeeping brand for owner-led businesses. Its purpose is to make the scope, handoff and month-end routine easier to understand. Replace this story with the client’s verified background and actual services. No CPA or tax credentials are implied.
split_title:
Less uncertainty.
A more useful month end.
split_body: Know what information is needed, when the books are reviewed and which reports you will receive. A clear scope helps the business owner and the bookkeeper work from the same page.
tagline: Organize the detail. See the bigger picture.
services: A repeatable routine for the essentials.
Describe the client’s agreed transaction review, reconciliations and month-end deliverables. The exact scope, software access and review process are confirmed during onboarding.
Ask which accounts, reports and recurring tasks are included.
A practical starting point for overdue books.
Review the periods involved, available records and outstanding questions before agreeing on a project scope. Timing depends on the condition and completeness of the source information.
A review comes before a promised completion date.
Turn organized records into a clearer handoff.
Explain the approved reports and how the client coordinates with the business owner and their tax professional. Tax preparation and financial advice are not implied.
Confirm the reports and handoff responsibilities in writing.
steps: Share the business type, general service interest and current recordkeeping approach.
The client confirms software, periods, deliverables, access controls and fees before work begins.
Set a document handoff, review schedule and communication routine suited to the business.
faqs: Not in this demo’s assumed scope. Only add tax services when the actual client confirms its qualifications and offerings.
No. This site has no document upload or secure client portal. Do not enter account numbers, tax IDs or financial records.
The client must approve supported products and any certifications. No software partnership is claimed by this template.
The actual client provides a scope and fee after reviewing the workload, periods involved and deliverables.
note: Do not enter account numbers, tax IDs or financial records. No accounting advice, software connection or document transfer is provided by this demo.
